leads_received.label: Leads received
leads_received.description: Unique leads received through API Leads. Partner retries with the same externalLeadId count once.

speed_to_lead_median_sec.label: Speed to lead (median seconds)
speed_to_lead_median_sec.description: Median seconds from a lead arriving to the AI agent's first call or text.

lead_to_booking_rate.label: Lead to booking rate
lead_to_booking_rate.description: Share of unique leads where the same resolved customer has a job booked within 14 days of the lead.

call_answer_rate.label: Call answer rate
call_answer_rate.description: Share of inbound voice calls (spam excluded) answered by the AI agent.

ai_call_booking_rate.label: AI call booking rate
ai_call_booking_rate.description: Share of inbound calls answered by the AI agent that ended with a booked job.

booked_revenue.label: Booked revenue from Broccoli
booked_revenue.description: Revenue of completed jobs that the AI agent booked (inbound calls or lead follow up).

completed_revenue.label: Completed job revenue (all sources)
completed_revenue.description: Revenue of all completed jobs, booked by any channel.

active_customers.label: Active customers
active_customers.description: Distinct resolved customers with at least one completed job.

revenue_per_customer.label: Revenue per active customer
revenue_per_customer.description: Completed job revenue divided by distinct resolved customers with a completed job.

membership_renewal_rate.label: Membership renewal rate
membership_renewal_rate.description: Share of memberships that ended on or before the as of date and were renewed by the same customer within 45 days.

invoice_collection_rate.label: Invoice collection rate
invoice_collection_rate.description: Amount paid divided by amount invoiced.

ticket_resolution_median_hours.label: Support resolution time (median hours)
ticket_resolution_median_hours.description: Median hours from a support ticket opening to being solved.

missed_calls.label: Missed inbound calls
missed_calls.description: Inbound voice calls (spam excluded) that nobody answered, including callers who hung up first.

after_hours_booked_revenue.label: Revenue the AI booked after hours
after_hours_booked_revenue.description: Revenue of completed jobs the AI agent booked before 8am or after 8pm local time, when the office is closed.

repeat_customer_rate.label: Repeat customer rate
repeat_customer_rate.description: Share of resolved customers with a completed job who have two or more completed jobs.

repeat_customers_found_by_matching.label: Repeat customers found only by matching
repeat_customers_found_by_matching.description: Resolved customers with two or more completed jobs where no single ServiceTitan customer id holds two of them. The field service system alone would not see them as repeat customers.
synonyms: repeat customers we only find by matching
